The money pays for teacher positions so computer science classes can be offered at high schools that do not have one now. The grant covers January 23, 2026 to June 30, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Agreement - Oakland Public Education Fund - Kapor Foundation - High School Linked Learning Office

enrichment.headline: Accepts up to $400,000 in state dual enrollment grants for four alternative high school programs
enrichment.summary: The district is accepting College and Career Access Pathways (CCAP) grants from the California Department of Education, $100,000 for each of four schools, for a total of up to $400,000. The grants support dual enrollment, where high school students take college courses. The schools are Independent Study, Sojourner Truth, MetWest High School, Ralph J. Bunche Continuation High and the Young Adult Program. The grants cover July 1, 2025 to December 31, 2027 and depend on the state having funds available.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Agreement - California Department of Education - College and Career Access Pathways Grant - 2025-2027 Dual Enrollment Opportunities – High School Linked Learning Office

enrichment.headline: Re-approves the 2025-26 year of a City of Oakland internship stipend grant, already accepted in December 2025; no new money
enrichment.summary: This is the City of Oakland's amendment for the 2025-26 year of an Oakland Fund for Children and Youth grant that pays stipends for students in summer internships in the Linked Learning program Exploring College, Career, and Community Options (ECCCO). It sets $225,000 a year for 2022-23 through 2025-26, a total of $900,000, with the term ending September 30, 2025. The Board had already accepted the 2025-26 $225,000 on December 10, 2025 (25-2573), so this vote adds no new money; it was approved after the term ended.

vendor.name: City of Oakland (Oakland Fund for Children and Youth)

items.fundingSource: Oakland Fund for Children and Youth

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.sourceIssue: The 2025-26 $225,000 was already accepted in 25-2573 (December 10, 2025). The text also prints the prior total as "$675,00.00", gives the prior end date as June 30, 2024, and calls this the First Amendment while the attached document calls itself the Second Amendment.
items.title: First Amendment, Grant Agreement - Kids First! - City of Oakland (OFCY) - High School Linked Learning Office

enrichment.headline: Pays Growing Together - Bay Area up to $8,000 for gardening classes at International Community School
enrichment.summary: Growing Together - Bay Area will teach hands-on gardening classes tied to school subjects and will develop and maintain the school garden at International Community School. The agreement runs August 11, 2025 to May 29, 2026, and the Board is being asked to ratify (formally approve after the fact) it.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Growing Together - Bay Area - International Community School

enrichment.headline: Pays The Finer Print up to $1,700 for a graphic supporting the district's whole-child commitment
enrichment.summary: The Finer Print, a Berkeley vendor, will design a graphic image that supports the district's commitment to educating the whole child: academic, social-emotional, behavioral and attendance. It will be developed with school leaders through the Multi-Tiered Systems of Support (MTSS) Department. The agreement runs November 3 to December 26, 2025, and the Board is being asked to ratify (formally approve after the fact) it.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - The Finer Print - Multi-Tiered Systems of Support Department (MTSS)

enrichment.headline: Pays Civic Productions up to $5,000 for community design projects at Castlemont High
enrichment.summary: Civic Productions LLC will help students in Castlemont High School's Sustainable Urban Design Academy (SUDA) create multiyear community projects with the academy's industry and community partners. The agreement runs January 1 to June 30, 2026, and the Board is being asked to ratify (formally approve after the fact) it.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Civic Productions LLC - Castlemont High School

enrichment.headline: Pays The Center for ArtEsteem up to $7,000 for visual arts and drumming classes at EnCompass Academy
enrichment.summary: The Center for ArtEsteem (Attitudinal Healing Connection, Inc.) will teach visual arts and music classes at EnCompass Academy. The classes end with a showcase of student artwork and drumming for families and the school community. The agreement runs September 3, 2025 to May 20, 2026, and the Board is being asked to ratify (formally approve after the fact) it.

vendor.name: Attitudinal Healing Connection, Inc., dba The Center for ArtEsteem

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Attitudinal Healing Connection, Inc., dba The Center for ArtEsteem - EnCompass Academy

enrichment.headline: Pays The Center for ArtEsteem up to $15,000 for a teaching artist at Hoover Elementary
enrichment.summary: The Center for ArtEsteem (Attitudinal Healing Connection, Inc.) will provide a resident teaching artist who works alongside classroom teachers to design lessons that bring art into math and English Language Arts (ELA) for students in kindergarten through 2nd grade at Hoover Elementary School. The agreement runs January 1 to May 29, 2026, and the Board is being asked to ratify (formally approve after the fact) it.

vendor.name: Attitudinal Healing Connection, Inc., dba The Center for ArtEsteem

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Attitudinal Healing Connection, Inc., dba The Center for ArtEsteem - Hoover Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $4,140 to run summer intern stipends for six Dewey students
enrichment.summary: Oakland Public Education Fund will act as fiscal facilitator and pay 2026 summer internship stipends for six high school students in the Exploring College, Career, & Community Options (ECCCO) program, charging a 15% administrative fee. The listed dates run from June 1, 2026 to January 30, 2026, which does not make sense as written.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.sourceIssue: The stated term runs from June 1, 2026 through January 30, 2026, so the end date falls before the start date and the agreement's term is unclear.
items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Oakland Public Education Fund - Dewey Academy

enrichment.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $16,500 for student data tracking at Rudsdale Continuation High
enrichment.summary: Oakland Public Education Fund will build tracking systems for academic and social-emotional data to support Rudsdale Continuation High School's Coordination of Services Team (COST), attendance team and academic counseling team. It will also train staff and support trimester progress monitoring. The agreement runs August 1, 2025 to May 28, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Oakland Public Education Fund - Rudsdale Continuation High School

enrichment.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $25,000 for mentoring Latinx young women at LIFE Academy
enrichment.summary: Oakland Public Education Fund will provide mentorship and support to 75 to 100 Latinx young women in grades 6-12 at LIFE Academy. Students meet in five support-circle groups that use somatic (body-based) exercises for mental health and mindfulness, and students who need more help get one-on-one mentoring. The agreement runs January 5 to May 28, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Oakland Public Education Fund - LIFE Academy

enrichment.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $23,973 for two media elective classes at MetWest High School
enrichment.summary: The district hires the Oakland Public Education Fund to teach two media elective classes, Video Production of MetWest Live and Yearbook, at Met West High School. Classes meet twice a week, on Tuesdays and Thursdays, from September 1, 2025 through May 31, 2026.

outcome.action: Withdrawn

pulled.summary: Taken off the consent report and withdrawn at this meeting.

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Oakland Public Education Fund - MetWest High School

enrichment.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $32,006.58 to handle summer internship stipends at Oakland High
enrichment.summary: The Oakland Public Education Fund acts as fiscal sponsor, meaning it processes and pays internship stipends for about 45 Oakland High School pathway students in the summer Exploring College, Career, and Community Options (ECCCO) Program. The agreement runs June 1 through June 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Oakland Public Education Fund - Oakland High School

enrichment.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $14,850 to run summer intern stipends at LIFE Academy
enrichment.summary: The Oakland Public Education Fund (OPEF) manages the stipend process for about 27 LIFE Academy student interns in the summer ECCCO (Exploring College, Career, and Community Options) work-based learning program. Each student gets $500, and the total includes OPEF's indirect costs. The agreement runs March 9 through May 28, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Oakland Public Education Fund - LIFE Academy

enrichment.headline: Approves Kids 1st Foundation's $69,000 historically Black colleges trip for McClymonds students
enrichment.summary: The Kids 1st Foundation arranged travel and lodging for 25 McClymonds High School students and 4 staff to visit seven historically Black colleges and universities, including airfare, charter bus, hotel, meals and cultural excursions. The Board is approving the agreement after the fact (ratifying it); its term began February 6, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Kids 1st Foundation - McClymonds High School

enrichment.headline: Approves Landmark Educational Tours' $67,000 six-day East Coast trip for Fremont High students
enrichment.summary: Landmark Educational Tours, of Middleton, Massachusetts, creates a customized six-day student trip to Washington, DC, Virginia and North Carolina for Fremont High School. The Board is approving the agreement after the fact (ratifying it); its term began February 1, 2026 and runs through June 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Landmark Educational Tours, LLC - Fremont High School

enrichment.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $14,300 to manage summer intern stipends at Sojourner Truth
enrichment.summary: The Oakland Public Education Fund manages the stipend process for paid summer work-based learning opportunities for 13 high school students at Sojourner Truth Independent Study Program. The agreement runs June 1 through June 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Oakland Public Education Fund - Sojourner Truth Independent Study Program

enrichment.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $34,000 for newcomer student support at Castlemont High
enrichment.summary: Bay Area Community Resources provides intensive support for Newcomer students at Castlemont High School, including one-on-one check-ins, tracking of attendance and grades, family communication, and help with immigration-related issues. The goal is better attendance and progress toward graduation. The agreement runs January 15 through June 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Bay Area Community Resources - Castlemont High School

enrichment.headline: Approves space80sevenllc's $58,000 music industry internship program for Fremont High Media Academy
enrichment.summary: space80sevenllc runs an eight-week internship-style program on the business of music media for ten Fremont High School Media Academy students. It includes mentorship from industry professionals and career field trips, including a two-day externship in Los Angeles. The Board is approving the agreement after the fact (ratifying it); its term began February 1, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - space80sevenllc - Fremont High School

enrichment.headline: Authorizes 63 Oakland Tech seniors to travel to the Oregon Shakespeare Festival in April
enrichment.summary: This resolution lets Oakland Technical High School take sixty-three 12th grade students to the Oregon Shakespeare Festival in Ashland, Oregon, from April 15 through April 17, 2026. The agenda lists no fiscal impact for the district.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Student Travel - Oregon Shakespeare Festival - Oakland Technical High School

enrichment.headline: Lets East Bay Innovation Academy use 3400 Malcolm Avenue, bringing the district about $248,909 in 2026-27
enrichment.summary: Under this Proposition 39 facilities agreement, East Bay Innovation Academy will use the district property at 3400 Malcolm Avenue for two years, July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2028. The district expects $248,909.10 in revenue in 2026-27. For 2027-28 it will charge 1.5 times the Proposition 39 per-square-foot rate; no dollar figure is given.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Proposition 39 Facilities Use Agreement - East Bay Innovation Academy - Charter School Office

enrichment.summary: The Board is ratifying (formally approving) the written minutes of its regular meeting held March 11, 2026. Staff prepared the minutes shortly after that meeting.

enrichment.summary: The Board is adopting an amendment to Board Bylaw 9322, which covers agendas and meeting materials. The changes are shown in a red-lined version in Exhibit A of the item.

enrichment.summary: This resolution adopts the Measure G1 oversight commission's recommendation to approve 2026-2027 Measure G1 applications, amended 2025-2026 applications, and a 2024-2025 carryover funding request for named schools. Measure G1 funds teacher retention and middle school improvement. The item text does not list dollar amounts or the schools.

enrichment.summary: This change order removes underground utility location, excavation, capping and backfilling work at four locations from the Asbestos Management Group contract for the Ralph Bunche and Hillside school site demolition projects. It lowers the contract's not-to-exceed amount from $612,000 to $604,000.

enrichment.summary: This change order adds money and time to DecoTech Systems' ongoing maintenance of security cameras and door entry systems across district sites, because of increased scope and the need to respond to vandalism. It raises the contract limit from $473,500 to $520,850 and extends the end date from August 15, 2026 to November 14, 2026.
